notes: Site: IKEA France (ikea.com/fr/fr). Homepage mega-menu 'Nouveautes' group and raw HTML links exposed https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/new/new-products/ (same base URL shape as UK/DE's /new/new-products/, only the locale segment differs). Opened with Playwright (tier 2, after tier-1 HTTP fetch showed only client-rendered nav JSON). H1/heading is 'Nouveau' / 'Nouveaux produits', page <title> 'Nouveaux produits - IKEA', on-page copy: "En quete de nouveautes dans l'assortiment IKEA ? Decouvrez nos dernieres nouveautes en matiere de mobilier et de decoration d'interieur a des prix abordables." - a genuine 'recently added to catalogue' merchandising concept with a real browsable/sortable/filterable product grid (Couleur, Taille, Type, Categorie, etc.), individual tiles carry a 'Nouveau' badge consistent with the page concept. The page also shows department 'chips' (Meubles de cuisine et electromenagers, Meubles et accessoires de salle de bain, Tables et chaises, Bebe et enfant, Canapes, Linge de maison & textile, Art de la table et ustensiles de cuisine, Meubles et accessoires de rangement, Luminaires et eclairage) - by analogy to the UK sibling's confirmed pattern these are query-param subcategory filters of the SAME base /new/new-products/ listing (e.g. the site's own raw-HTML sample links use '?filters=f-subcategories:<id>'), not distinct site-curated New Arrivals sub-pages, so no sub-categories were invented; only the canonical unfiltered URL is emitted. Page text shows '712 elements' twice (page header + filter-panel header) and the results-list footer independently confirms 'Affiche 24 resultats sur 712' - qty verified reliable. No 'New Collection'/'Nouvelle collection'-style editorial page found needing the ambiguous-Collection review. Checked https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/cat/lower-price/ ('Prix baisse') in passing - its filter panel shows a 'Nouveaux produits' sub-facet (14 products) but that is an in-page facet of the separate Lower-Price/value listing (see cl140.json notes), not a New Arrivals PLP itself, so not recorded here. No other New Arrivals-labelled entry point found in nav, footer, offers hub, or raw-HTML term search ('nouveaute', 'nouveaux produits', 'derniers arrivages', 'nouvelle collection'). No Claude-specific disallow in robots.txt; did not need Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).

rows.evidence: Rendered page text (Playwright render of https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/new/new-products/): '712 elements' shown twice (page header below H1 'Nouveaux produits', and again as sort-and-filter panel header) and 'Affiche 24 resultats sur 712' (results-list footer) - all three consistent.
